extracted_concepts.name: Number and Algebra
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: IB math topic covering sequences, exponents, logarithms, and complex numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: IB math topic covering graphs, transformations, and function types.

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometry
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: IB math topic covering radian measure, identities, and trigonometric equations.

extracted_concepts.name: Vectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: IB math topic covering vectors, dot product, cross product, and lines and planes in 3D.

extracted_concepts.name: Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: IB math topic covering limits, differentiation, and integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability and Statistics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: IB math topic covering data, probability, distributions, and statistical inference.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic Sequences
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with common difference d and nth term a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of terms of an arithmetic sequence: S_n = n/2 [2a_1 + (n-1)d].

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Sequences
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequence with common ratio r and nth term a_n = a_1 r^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of first n terms of a geometric sequence: S_n = a_1(1-r^n)/(1-r).

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of all terms of a geometric series when |r| < 1: S_infinity = a_1/(1-r).

extracted_concepts.name: Laws of Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules such as a^m a^n = a^(m+n) and (a^m)^n = a^(mn).

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse of exponentiation: log_a(x) = y iff a^y = x.

extracted_concepts.name: Complex Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers of the form z = a + bi where i^2 = -1.

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Form of Complex Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Representation z = r(cos theta + i sin theta) using modulus and argument.

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Polynomial function f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c.

extracted_concepts.name: Discriminant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Delta = b^2 - 4ac; determines the nature of quadratic roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form f(x) = P(x)/Q(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Asymptotes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines a rational graph approaches; vertical when Q(x) = 0, horizontal by degree comparison.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form f(x) = a^x, including the natural exponential e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function of the form f(x) = log_a(x), including ln x.

extracted_concepts.name: Radian Measure
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure defined so that arc length s = r theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Length of a circular arc given by s = r theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric Identities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Identities such as sin^2 x + cos^2 x = 1 and tan x = sin x / cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Double Angle Formulas
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Formulas like sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Vector product given by a dot b = |a||b| cos theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Cross Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 3D vector product with magnitude |a x b| = |a||b| sin theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Parametric Equations of Lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Parametric equations for a line in 3D using a position vector and a direction vector.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector Equation of a Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation of a plane in 3D using position and direction vectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Limits
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Value a function approaches; foundation for continuity and calculus.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding a derivative, including rules and applications.

extracted_concepts.name: Chain Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Derivative rule for composite functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of finding an antiderivative or area under a curve; inverse of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Theorem linking differentiation and definite integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given that another event has occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Bayes' Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Theorem that updates probability estimates using conditional information.

extracted_concepts.name: Binomial Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Discrete distribution for the number of successes in a fixed number of trials.

extracted_concepts.name: Normal Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Continuous bell-shaped probability distribution.

extracted_concepts.name: Central Limit Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sampling distribution of the mean approaches a normal distribution for large samples.

extracted_concepts.name: Hypothesis Testing
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistical procedure using z-test, t-test, or chi-square test to make decisions.
